characterization_methods: Depth profiling with argon ion sputtering
evidence: XPS spectra were excited by non-monochromatized MgK radiation and measured using 89 eV analyzer energy and 0.5 eV channel width. Film morphology was examined with a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope (SEM). A Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer using Cu radiation was employed in crystal structure determination. Film thicknesses were determined by fitting transmittance spectra using a procedure developed and described by Ylilammi and Ranta-aho. The content of chlorine residues increased slightly with increasing depth being in average about 3 at.%. Since the oxygen content decreased and nitrogen content increased when going deeper into the film, the origin of oxygen was ascribed to a post deposition oxidation of the film surface.
